definitions.explanation: A location further along in space.
Time that has not yet come.
The pointed or far end of something.

examples.english: There is a station ahead on this road.

notes:
{先|さき} is a highly versatile noun with spatial, temporal, and physical meanings.

SPATIAL (ahead):
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{先|さき}: ahead of here, beyond this point
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{先|さき}: a little further ahead

TEMPORAL (future / earlier):
- {先|さき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧: what will happen / future matters
- {先|さき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: first, beforehand (doing something before others)
- ⟦{先|さき}ほど→先ほど：04165_sakihodo⟧: a short while ago (polite)

PHYSICAL (tip):
- ⟦{指|ゆび}{先|さき}→指先：12727_yubisaki⟧: fingertip
- ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先|さき}: pencil tip

COMMON PHRASES:
- ⟦お→お：03097_o⟧{先|さき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}します→失礼します：21922_shitsureishimasu⟧: Excuse me for leaving first (workplace farewell)
- ⟦お→お：03097_o⟧{先|さき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧: After you / Please go ahead

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{行|い}き{先|さき}→行き先：16779_ikisaki⟧: destination
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: teacher (literally 'born before')
- ⟦{先回|さきまわ}り→先回り：25673_sakimawari⟧: getting ahead of / anticipating
